items.text: Among patients aged 65 or over on a 28-bed geriatric medicine ward from October to December 2026, what proportion of eligible patient-shifts have a delirium screen that was performed, and how does this differ by shift, weekday or weekend, dementia, sensory loss and side-room care?
items.population: Patients aged 65 or over present on the ward during a nursing shift
items.intervention: Shift type, weekday or weekend, dementia, sensory loss and side-room care (exposures)
items.comparator: Day shifts on weekdays; patients without dementia or sensory loss in open bays
items.outcome: Screen performed on the patient-shift (documented and, on observed shifts, witnessed)

finer: Feasible with 0.4 FTE for 12 weeks and no extra ward paperwork; interesting to nursing and geriatrics; novel locally; ethical under the approved consent model; relevant because it decides where improvement starts.
summary: One descriptive PECO question with pre-specified strata.
